title: Magic wand with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='wand' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8B5CF6'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#6D28D9'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='star' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FDE68A'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#F59E0B'/>

  </defs>
  <!-- wand stick -->
  <line x1='30' y1='88' x2='62' y2='40' stroke='#8B5CF6' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='88' x2='62' y2='40' stroke='#A78BFA' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handle stripe -->
  <line x1='36' y1='78' x2='44' y2='66' stroke='#C4B5FD' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <polygon points='65,8 71,26 90,26 75,37 80,55 65,44 50,55 55,37 40,26 59,26' fill='url(#star)' stroke='#FBBF24' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <circle cx='88' cy='12' r='3' fill='#FDE68A'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='14' r='2.2' fill='#FDE68A'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#FDE68A'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='62' r='2' fill='#FDE68A'/>
  <path d='M14 60 l3 6 l6 3 l-6 3 l-3 6 l-3 -6 l-6 -3 l6 -3 z' fill='#FCD34D'/>
</svg>
